title: Ezekiel's visitors appear as wheels covered in eyes
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ezekiel's visitors appear as wheels covered in eyes, about biblical era at Babylon (biblical), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Ezekiel's visitors arrive as interlocking wheels covered in eyes, wrapped in fire and storm.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a vision from the Book of Ezekiel, a book of the Bible set in Babylon. In his telling, the visitors who come to the prophet Ezekiel look like wheels fitted inside each other, covered in eyes and wrapped in fire and storm. He brings it up as a possible ancient account of contact with something not human.
